meta.title: Dragon Maid
meta.description: Dragon Maid changes form with your model's reasoning effort.

config.name: Maid name; empty uses the default name.
config.followModels: Wildcard patterns of the models the maid follows, e.g. gpt*, claude-*, provider/model.

illustrations.$desc: Custom illustration per form (image URL or data URL); empty keeps the built-in artwork.

config.visible: Show the maid in the conversation.
config.showCaption: Show the name and form caption.
config.stage: Displayed form: auto follows the reasoning effort.
config.divineGlow: Animate the divine radiance of the max form.
config.character: Character: auto picks the Claude maid for claude models, the DeepSeek maid for deepseek models, otherwise the dragon maid.
